name: io.github.hughhan1/mysql
description: MySQL statements and transactions over MCP

environmentVariables.name: DATABASE_URL
environmentVariables.description: SQLAlchemy mysql+pymysql URL for one existing MySQL 8.4 database.

environmentVariables.name: CLOUD_SQL_INSTANCE
environmentVariables.description: Optional Cloud SQL project:region:instance; connects through its private IP.

environmentVariables.name: TRANSACTION_TIMEOUT
environmentVariables.description: Maximum MCP transaction-handle lifetime in positive seconds; defaults to 30.

environmentVariables.name: TRANSACTION_IDLE_TIMEOUT
environmentVariables.description: MCP transaction-handle idle timeout in positive seconds; defaults to 10. Independent of MySQL wait_timeout.

environmentVariables.name: WAIT_TIMEOUT
environmentVariables.description: Optional MySQL session wait_timeout in seconds; otherwise uses the server setting.

environmentVariables.name: INNODB_LOCK_WAIT_TIMEOUT
environmentVariables.description: Optional MySQL session innodb_lock_wait_timeout in seconds; otherwise uses the server setting.

environmentVariables.name: CONNECT_TIMEOUT
environmentVariables.description: Optional PyMySQL connect_timeout in seconds; otherwise uses the driver default.

environmentVariables.name: READ_TIMEOUT
environmentVariables.description: Optional PyMySQL read_timeout in seconds; otherwise uses the driver default.

environmentVariables.name: WRITE_TIMEOUT
environmentVariables.description: Optional PyMySQL write_timeout in seconds; otherwise uses the driver default.

environmentVariables.name: POOL_SIZE
environmentVariables.description: Optional SQLAlchemy pool_size; otherwise uses the library default.

environmentVariables.name: MAX_OVERFLOW
environmentVariables.description: Optional SQLAlchemy max_overflow; otherwise uses the library default.

environmentVariables.name: POOL_TIMEOUT
environmentVariables.description: Optional SQLAlchemy pool_timeout in seconds; otherwise uses the library default.
